parameters.content:
## Coverflex prospect chatbot (RAG)
**Part A (top):** scrape coverflex.com -> clean -> chunk -> embed -> Pinecone. Run manually once (and again when the site changes).
**Part B (bottom):** public chat -> AI agent -> searches the knowledge base on every question -> answers only from Coverflex content.

**Setup:** one Google Gemini API key (embeddings + chat) and Pinecone. Pinecone index `coverflex-kb`, dimension 3072 (gemini-embedding-001), cosine.

### 1. Scraping
Sitemaps first: they list every public page, so no crawler is needed. Two sitemaps: English Portugal site (`/en-pt`) and the Portuguese site (`/pt`), because the full FAQ answers (e.g. pricing) are on the Portuguese pages. About 120 pages kept: products, pricing + FAQ, solutions, industries, customer stories, platform news. Blog, legal, simulators and the 2,000+ nursery directory pages are skipped (noise).
Pages are fetched in batches of 5 with a 1s pause to be polite to the site.

### 2. Cleaning, chunking, embedding
The menu, forms, scripts and any line repeated on more than 20% of pages (footer, banners) are removed before embedding, otherwise every chunk would look alike and retrieval gets worse.
Chunks of ~1,000 characters with 150 overlap: big enough to keep a FAQ question with its answer, small enough to retrieve precisely. Each chunk keeps its source URL and title as metadata (for citations).
`Clear namespace` on insert, so a re-run replaces old content instead of duplicating it.

### 3. Chat (RAG at answer time)
Public chat trigger = the production webhook to test.
The agent must call the knowledge-base tool first (top 5 chunks), and answers only from them; if nothing relevant comes back it says so and offers a demo, instead of inventing prices or tax rules.
Window memory (last 10 messages) so follow-ups like "and for 20 people?" work.
Model: Gemini 2.5 Flash (fast and cheap for a website chat; any chat model can be swapped in). Temperature low for factual answers.

### What I would add in production
- Schedule trigger (weekly re-scrape) + alert if a page fails.
- Separate namespaces per market (PT/ES/IT/DE) and route by language.
- Log every question + retrieved chunks to a sheet/HubSpot: shows content gaps and buying intent.
- Hand-off: if the visitor gives company + email, create the contact in HubSpot and a task for a BDR.
- Eval set of 20 real questions to check answers after each change.

parameters.initialMessages: Hi! I'm the Coverflex assistant. Ask me anything about meal cards, benefits, insurance or pricing.

options.systemMessage:
You are Coverflex's website assistant for prospects (companies that do not use Coverflex yet).

How to answer:
1. ALWAYS search the coverflex_knowledge_base tool before answering any question about Coverflex (products, pricing, plans, meal card, insurance, childcare, Flexpay, budgets, pay transparency, job offers, AI, integrations, customers).
2. Answer ONLY with facts found in the retrieved content. If the answer is not there, say you are not sure and offer a call with the team: https://www.coverflex.com/en-pt/lets-talk . Never invent prices, tax rules or features.
3. Reply in the language the user writes in (Portuguese, English, Spanish or Italian).
4. Keep answers short (2-5 sentences), friendly and concrete. End with the source page URL when useful.
5. When it fits naturally, ask one qualifying question (company size, country, what they use today for meal allowance or benefits) and suggest a demo for next steps.
6. If the user is an existing customer or employee with a support issue, point them to Coverflex support instead of answering account-specific questions.
7. Tax and legal values can change: present them as "according to our website" and recommend confirming with the team.
